title: Mutate through an exclusive borrow
summary: Grow a string through a mutable reference, then borrow it for inspection and reuse the owner after each call.

exclusive.clue: Parameter reference type allowing add_tag to grow the caller’s String

slice.clue: Borrowed UTF-8 slice type for tag; the function does not own the tag

separator.clue: String method appending a single separator character

append.clue: String method appending the whole tag slice

countType.clue: Pointer-sized unsigned integer returned by the byte length method

count.clue: Method returning the byte length of text

binding.clue: Binding modifier allowing name to be borrowed exclusively

argument.clue: Operator and modifier creating an exclusive borrow of name at the first add_tag call

shared.clue: Operator creating a shared borrow of name for byte_count

assertion.clue: Macro checking the final string after appending an empty tag
